title: Packages left in unsafe or exposed locations by drivers
situation: Immediate review is required because multiple customers report ruined or vulnerable deliveries left outside, risking further loss and chargebacks.
hypothesis: Drivers leaving packages in unsafe or exposed locations

params.reply_en: We are sorry your packages were left in an unsafe spot. We are investigating this with our delivery partner and have issued a free replacement for your ruined items.
params.reply_ar: نعتذر عن ترك شحناتكم في مكان غير آمن. نحن نحقق في الأمر مع شركة التوصيل وأصدرنا بديلاً مجانياً للطلبات المتضررة.

actions.why: Acknowledge the unsafe drop-off and confirm replacements.

actions.reason: Packages left in unsafe locations and damaged

actions.note: Driver delivery protocol violation regarding safe drop-off locations.
